newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July-Sept industry output seen up 0.3% q/q. [CORRECTED 06:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Japan July-Sept industry output seen up 0.3% q/q. [CORRECTED 06:32 GMT]

text.p: Japan's industrial production in the July-September quarter is expected to rise 0.3 percent from the previous quarter and to rise 4.8 percent (corrects from 7.6 percent) from the same period a year earlier, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Wednesday.
A ministry official said industrial production continued to be on a favourable uptrend.

He added that output in the April-June quarter had been unchanged from the previous quarter, a result which was favourable considering the high output in the January-March period and considering the effect on output of the rise in the sales tax on April 1.
Even after high output in the January-March quarter, firms increased inventories in April-June, supporting output, he said.
